概要 / A MOMENT, KEPT

The chain keeps moving.
Your night stays.

Minting captures the block your transaction lands in. Its own onchain information becomes a seed for one of eight animated worlds. No numbers to choose. No images to upload.

The art lives in the contract. Every pixel, colour and frame is generated in Solidity whenever it’s read. Your block becomes a six-second loop. Yours to keep.

案内 / HOW TO WALK

Find your way.

Walking

↑ / W
Walk on. Hold to hurry.
↓ / S
Stop. Hold to step back.
← → / A D
Turn at the next junction or into a doorway. Press again to cancel.
T
Turn around.
Mouse / drag
Look around.
Enter / E
Use what’s in front of you: a ticket gate, the mint terminal, a train.
Esc
Leave a place, or return to the overview.

Places

  • 地下鉄 Subway. Tap a ticket gate (改札) to connect your wallet, then ride the train to the mountains.
  • ギャラリー Gallery. Mint at the terminal (鋳造). Minted blocks hang on its walls.
  • ラーメン Ramen shop. Say hello to the chef.
  • 桜川 Sakuragawa. A riverside station among the cherry blossoms.

Glowing lines on the pavement mark doorways. The map in the corner shows where each place is.
